dialogue.htmlContent: You find yourself walking down yet another of Elis's narrow passages, lined by the usual series of inset doorways, discarded trash, and questionable stains. This time, however, as you're turning a corner, you notice two strangers ahead acting suspiciously though they don't appear to have noticed you yet. One figure, draped in a trench-coat and fedora, is lurking in the dark and from what you can tell seems to be waiting impatiently while the wolf-boy before them fidgets nervously.

It doesn't look like the usual mugging or solicitation attempt so, out of curiosity, you quickly hide behind a stack of crates to observe the situation. Peering from cover, you see the wolf-boy nervously adjusting the watch around his wrist. After a brief exchange he nods, handing a handful of flames to the other person adorned with a trench-coat and fedora. The mysterious figure takes the flames, counts them, and puts them somewhere deep in their coat before pulling something out and exchanging it. The wolf-boy quickly grabs whatever it is and hurries down the passage, vanishing behind a corner and into the twisting alleyways. Once he's gone, the trench-coat-clad person takes a furtive glance around as you duck back behind the crates. When you peek back around they're leaning against the wall, presumably awaiting another customer...

Curious as to what's going on you continue your way down the alley. Startled by the sound of your approach, the wolf-boy yelps, dropping a bag of flames and fleeing down the alley away from you and the stranger. Watching as their apparent customer vanishes around a corner the figure lets out a sigh before slowly crouching down and pocketing the flames on the floor. Even from this distance it's hard to make out their identity in the poor lighting as they turn to face you, arms crossed in silence, and lean against the nearby wall waiting to see what you want...
Deciding it's best to avoid this for now, you turn down a different passage, returning to the maze like alleyways of Elis.

A feminine voice breaks the ice as the figure motions you over. [AceXpElisTrader.speech(You’re no enforcer, so, wanna buy something?)] [pc.speech(Uh, sure, what’ve you got?)] you say, the saleswoman chuckling quietly. [AceXpElisTrader.speech(Figured…)] [AceXpElisTrader.She] [AceXpElisTrader.verb(step)] out of the shadows revealing herself to be a [AceXpElisTrader.race]. Opening her trench-coat, [AceXpElisTrader.she] reveals a horde of wares hanging inside, as well as showing off her white t-shirt and blue-grey jeans, which hug her large breasts and plump thighs.
The [AceXpElisTrader.race] nods, wordlessly leaving in the opposite direction.

Walking through the maze-like alleyways, you turn a corner and spot the shady trench-coat-clad saleswoman leaning against a wall. [AceXpElisTrader.She] calls out seeing you walk her way [AceXpElisTrader.speech(Hey, stranger, wanna buy something?)]
The [AceXpElisTrader.race] leans against the wall, awaiting your next move.

You ask the panda-girl about herself and she raises a hand. [AceXpElisTrader.speech(Listen #IF(pc.isFeminine())lady#ELSEpal#ENDIF, I exchange goods and flames, not personal information. Not to be rude, but, if you’re not here to buy something, I’m not interested.)]

You ask the panda-girl where she gets her goods from and she raises an eyebrow then simply responds. [AceXpElisTrader.speech(A friend, and that’s all I’ll say.)] You then decide to ask her about the legality of what she sells. [AceXpElisTrader.speech(You mean to ask if my dirt cheap sterility pills and second-hand watches are legal? Of course! What’s with these questions, you an informant or something?)]

You get a little bit closer to her and proposition the panda-girl with having some fun, causing her to raise an eyebrow. [AceXpElisTrader.speech(#IF(pc.isFeminine())Lady#ELSEPal#ENDIF, I’m selling my stuff not myself, not to mention I don’t do my customers.)] Sensing some disappointment, she pats your shoulder. [AceXpElisTrader.speech(Sorry… Nothing personal.)]
